reviewer_scope: Independent read-only saved-evidence audit; no physics/model calls and no source writes. Newly created validation receipt only.
caveats: The original full FollowupProbe object is not serialized in standalone form. Its runtime full-result repeat comparison PASS is checked in the compute timing records; this audit independently rereads complete initial snapshots/StepResults and all saved diagnostic arrays, but cannot recreate unsaved final integration snapshots without physics.
IO timings are from an already authenticated source load and repeated filesystem state. No cold-cache inference. cProfile data is separate from principal timings.
Compute env_step includes unchanged environment contact diagnostics, not isolated MuJoCo engine time.

For a future compute benchmark, an exception inside the original/repeat comparator occurs before normal raw persistence and is outside the run_followup_probe exception-preservation block. All 27 successful runs in this completed benchmark preserved and authenticated their raw data; no such exception occurred.
This audit authenticates the source hashes recorded before/after the producer runs and current source hashes. It does not independently observe intervening filesystem history.
